title: CV Health Observer
tagline: A privacy-preserving monitoring system designed to detect health emergencies and abnormal activity patterns in vulnerable individuals.
description: CV Health Observer is a privacy-preserving monitoring system designed to detect health emergencies and abnormal activity patterns in vulnerable individuals. Computer vision and vision-language models run on-device via Edge AI, so video never needs to leave the local environment. An LLM layer interprets detected patterns into actionable alerts for caregivers — without storing identifiable footage in the cloud.
highlights: On-device Edge AI inference — video stays local, no cloud streaming of identifiable footage
Computer vision pipeline for fall, inactivity, and abnormal motion pattern detection
Vision-language models (VML) to describe scenes without exposing raw video
LLM layer that turns detections into caregiver-ready alerts
